text: Gus put the locket on Dunn’s desk and said nothing. It worked better than shouting.
Dunn sighed, unlocked a drawer, and took out the wrecked boat’s registry plate.
No owner. No port. No crew. Just a name painted on the bow.
She was called the Keeper’s Daughter.
Gus never had a sister. His mother was the keeper’s only daughter.
And she was lost at sea the night he was born.
